description: Play Booster collation model for Reality Fracture Sealed. Sources: WotC 'Collecting Reality Fracture' and the mtgscribe Play Booster fact sheet (2026-09-08); the two agree. Slot weights are raw as published; the simulator normalizes each slot's weights to sum to 1 and records the residual it absorbed.

groups.main_common: rarity=common, in the 270-card main numbering (excludes the 10 common duals and the basics). Contains exactly one land, Room of Refuge.
groups.dual_common_land: the 10 common '{T}: Add {X} or {Y}' lands (Annex / Commons cycle)

slots.note: common 98.18% / Special Guest 1.82%. ASSUMPTION: the Special Guest is off-set and unplayable in this Sealed model, so the slot always yields a main-set common.
common 23% / non-paired uncommon 74% / other 3%. ASSUMPTION: the 3% folds into non-paired uncommon.
Draw one rarity, pick one pair of that rarity uniformly, add both halves. Raw weights sum to 0.970; the simulator normalizes.
Third echoed-pair card, drawn from the same rarity distribution. ASSUMPTION: independent of the pair in slots 9-10 (it may duplicate a half already drawn).
rare 74.4% / mythic 14.8% / booster-fun variants 10.8%. ASSUMPTION: the variants are still set rares/mythics, so the 10.8% is split proportionally, giving R 83.4% / M 16.6%.

traditional foil, any main-set card including echoed-pair halves. Raw weights sum to 0.972; the 2.8% residual is normalized away proportionally. ASSUMPTION: 'full main set' means the 270-card main numbering, so the 10 common duals are not in the foil slot.

land slot. WotC 'Collecting Reality Fracture' lists: default basic non-foil 14.6% + foil 3.6%; tower basic non-foil 21.8% + foil 5.5%; common dual non-foil 43.6% + foil 10.9%. Duals total 54.5% (a foil dual is still a dual). The earlier 0.436 counted only the non-foil duals (CEO error, caught in the DEC-925 self-review 2026-09-23). Cross-check: taw/magic-search-engine PR #636 weights duals 30/55 = 54.5%. Basics are dropped from the pool (unlimited supply at the event).

promo.note: ASSUMPTION (flagged, board to confirm from the pack): one date-stamped card drawn uniformly over the 64 main-set rares + 26 main-set mythics, i.e. 64/90 vs 26/90. Set promo.enabled=false to simulate pools without it.

sanity_targets.source: CEO arithmetic in the DEC-926 spec; dual_land corrected to 0.545 on 2026-09-23 (foil duals counted)
sanity_targets.known_divergence: The CEO's uncommon target 4.81 was computed from the raw published weights for slots 8, 9-11 and 13, which sum to 0.97-0.972 rather than 1. Under any model that normalizes those slots the uncommon expectation is ~4.94. Commons, rares+mythics and duals land inside +/-0.05; uncommons are ~0.13 high by construction, not by sampler error. Flagged for the CEO in the handoff.
